rationale.conceptual: The method is a standard, non-trivial DFT workflow (surface slabs, spin-polarized relaxations, magnetic moment extraction, FM/AFM coupling) that demands understanding of crystallography, defect chemistry, and electronic-structure codes. It is not a novel algorithm, but correctly setting up the specific defect configurations and interpreting the results requires careful implementation of an established multi-component method.
rationale.execution: The workflow has sequential stages (bulk relaxation → slab construction → many defect relaxations) totalling about 22 independent DFT runs, plus environment preparation (Quantum ESPRESSO, pseudopotentials). It is a moderate multi-stage pipeline with standard tooling, but the repetition is straightforward; no extremely fragile orchestration or complex data assembly.
